mentions.name: One-Article-a-Day Android Reading App
mentions.description: An Android app that helps people actually read what they save by allowing only one saved article per day; finishing today's read unlocks the next one. Twitter, Reddit, and similar posts can be saved separately and revisited anytime. Currently validating demand, with a waitlist for a planned small closed Android beta.
mentions.problem: Saved blogs and articles pile up but are almost never revisited or read.
mentions.audience: The author's own daily reading (personal use), with broader interest being validated for a closed beta
mentions.source_excerpt: So I’m building an Android app designed to help me actually read what I save. You only get one saved article per day. Finish today’s read to unlock the next one. You can also save Twitter, Reddit, etc. posts separately and revisit them anytime.
